script:
local Fluent = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
local SaveManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/Addons/SaveManager.lua"))()
local InterfaceManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/Addons/InterfaceManager.lua"))()

local Window = Fluent:CreateWindow({
	Title = "Rebirth Hack",
	SubTitle = "by Plutomaster",
	TabWidth = 160,
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
	Acrylic = true,
	Theme = "Dark",
	MinimizeKey = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
})

local Tabs = {
	Main = Window:AddTab({Title = "Main", Icon = "zap"}),
	Settings = Window:AddTab({Title = "Settings", Icon = "settings"})
}

local RebirthList = {
	{Name = "1 Rebirth", ID = "tier1"},
	{Name = "3 Rebirths", ID = "tier2"},
	{Name = "9 Rebirths", ID = "tier3"},
	{Name = "34 Rebirths", ID = "tier4"},
	{Name = "120 Rebirths", ID = "tier5"},
	{Name = "720 Rebirths", ID = "tier6"},
	{Name = "4k Rebirths", ID = "tier7"},
	{Name = "17k Rebirths", ID = "tier8"},
	{Name = "75k Rebirths", ID = "tier9"},
	{Name = "240k Rebirths", ID = "tier10"},
	{Name = "1.2M Rebirths", ID = "tier11"},
	{Name = "15M Rebirths", ID = "tier12"},
	{Name = "80M Rebirths", ID = "tier13"},
	{Name = "400M Rebirths", ID = "tier14"},
	{Name = "2B Rebirths", ID = "tier15"},
	{Name = "13B Rebirths", ID = "tier16"},
	{Name = "40B Rebirths", ID = "tier17"},
	{Name = "500B Rebirths", ID = "tier18"},
	{Name = "925B Rebirths", ID = "tier19"},
	{Name = "4.25T Rebirths", ID = "tier20"},
	{Name = "65T Rebirths", ID = "tier21"},
	{Name = "790T Rebirths", ID = "tier22"},
	{Name = "8.46qa Rebirths", ID = "tier23"},
	{Name = "50qa Rebirths", ID = "tier24"}
}

local Names = {}
for _, v in ipairs(RebirthList) do
	table.insert(Names, v.Name)
end

local tier = "tier1"
local auto = false
local speed = 0.1

local drop = Tabs.Main:AddDropdown("Tier", {
	Title = "Select Rebirth Tier",
	Values = Names,
	Default = "1 Rebirth"
})

drop:OnChanged(function(v)
	for _, d in ipairs(RebirthList) do
		if d.Name == v then
			tier = d.ID
			break
		end
	end
end)

Tabs.Main:AddButton({
	Title = "Rebirth Now",
	Description = "Instant rebirth with selected tier",
	Callback = function()
		game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RebirthEvent"):FireServer(tier)
		Fluent:Notify({Title = "Rebirth", Content = "Used " .. tier, Duration = 3})
	end
})

local toggle = Tabs.Main:AddToggle("Auto", {Title = "Enable Auto Rebirth", Default = false})
toggle:OnChanged(function(v)
	auto = v
end)

local slider = Tabs.Main:AddSlider("Speed", {
	Title = "Auto Speed (Seconds)",
	Default = 0.1,
	Min = 0.1,
	Max = 5,
	Rounding = 2
})

slider:OnChanged(function(v)
	speed = v
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if auto and tier then
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RebirthEvent"):FireServer(tier)
		end
		task.wait(speed)
	end
end)

SaveManager:SetLibrary(Fluent)
InterfaceManager:SetLibrary(Fluent)
SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({})
InterfaceManager:SetFolder("FluentScriptHub")
SaveManager:SetFolder("FluentScriptHub/RebirthGUI")
InterfaceManager:BuildInterfaceSection(Tabs.Settings)
SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(Tabs.Settings)
Window:SelectTab(1)
Fluent:Notify({Title = "Rebirth GUI", Content = "Loaded", Duration = 4})
SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
